run_distogram_evaluation: run distogram inference evaluation on protein structures using a checkpoint and config file
run_contact_map_prediction: run contact map prediction by aggregating crops across a protein domain sequence
compute_single_prediction: compute the contact map for a single protein domain using cropped patches
compute_single_patch: compute output predictions for a single crop of 2D input features
create_prediction_namedtuple: create a Prediction namedtuple to store distogram inference outputs including softmax probabilities and secondary structure
